logp.method_description: A partitioning mixture using n-octanol and water (Tris HCl buffer) was continuously stirred for 24 h and then kept for layer separation overnight. The same partitioning solvents were used for all the experiments related to lipophilicity determination. Standard calibration plots were prepared by varying the concentration of metal complexes from 10 to 80 μM and a linear fitting plot gives the values of slope and intercept in both cases. Finally, a known amount of (60 μM for both 1 and 2) complexes was taken in and an equal volume of octanol and water solvent mixture and the reaction mixture was continuously shaken for 30 min and kept for layer separation and later the UV-vis spectrum was recorded from both the layers and from the calibration curves equation and using the obtained slope and intercept values in both cases we calculated the dissolved concentration of metal complexes 1 and 2 in both octanol as well as water (buffer) layer. Finally, the log Poct/buff values were calculated for both 1 and 2 and compared.
